column1: # Labels for the phishing_pot collection (https://github.com/rf-peixoto/phishing_pot), English emails only.
# One line per file: file name, label (1 = scam, 0 = not a scam), and the campaign it belongs to.
# Labeled by reading each campaign against the rules in data/SOURCES.md (October 2026).
# Near-identical emails were grouped into campaigns; at most 3 files per campaign are listed.
# Files not listed are not imported: unclear, another language, no readable text, or one of the
# categories that are a judgment call (casino, dating/adult, health and supplement promotions).
